name: 02-post-query-users-by-name
description: The IT's form (object=user, field=email, searchKey=name, searchValue=mule) builds "SELECT id, name ,email from user where name like '%mule%'" and returns every record; reply.txt lines (Email=..., Id=..., Name=...) are all contained. Response text = Mule ObjectToString (byte-array-to-string-transformer) of the list of per-record strings: CollectionUtils.toString(list, 50) of MapUtils.toString(record) - verified against mule-core-3.8.0 bytecode; records are the connector's HashMap (field order as in the README log of authenticating-salesforce-using-oauth2).

source.reference: salesforce-data-retrieval/src/main/app/salesforce-id-retrieval.xml (flow salesforceDataRetrievalFlow: sfdc:query-all with the MEL query, foreach byte-array-to-string + 'flowVars.response + payload', set-payload #[response], byte-array-to-string, catch-exception-strategy 'Invalid Salesforce query.'); SalesforceIdRetrievalIT#testGetData + src/test/resources/reply.txt

queryParams.q: SELECT id, name ,email from user where name like '%mule%'
SELECT id, name ,email from user where name like '%mule%'

expected.body: [{Email=kicks+a@mulesoft.com, Id=00520000003LtYCAA0, type=User, Name=Mule orgA}, {Email=kicks+a-integration@mulesoft.com, Id=00520000003LtvGAAS, type=User, Name=Mule orgA Integration}]
